paragraphs: I'm a multimedia producer and livestream technician in Denver. For more than 20 years I've made documentary, public-affairs, music and event video, from the field camera to the edit and the final delivery.

Today I run multi-camera hybrid services and events for a Denver congregation. I also come from the technical side, with years of Microsoft 365 and business-systems support behind reliable live production. I like work where the story and the technology both have to hold up.

home.hero_line: Technology that keeps working, and video that tells your story.
home.intro_heading: What I can do for you
home.intro: I help small businesses, churches, nonprofits and community organisations with two kinds of work: the technology that keeps an office running, and the audio and video that gets a message out. They are separate services, so pick the one you need. Or start with a conversation and I will point you the right way.
home.ai_heading: Where the two meet: AI and automation
home.ai_text: Both tracks reward the same habits: spot the work that repeats, check it carefully, and keep a person in charge. If that sounds useful, there is a short page about it.
home.proof_intro: Videos from the AV and media track. Open a case study to see what I did and why it mattered.
home.wall_intro: A wider look at videos from across the work. Each one opens on YouTube.

how_it_works.text: We have a short conversation about what you need and what is getting in the way.
We agree one small, clearly scoped piece of work to start with, so you can see how it goes.
I do the work and explain it in plain words.
I check back, fix what needs fixing, and we decide together what comes next.

client.first_step_title: A first conversation, then a small first step

services.title: IT & Systems for small business
services.description: Microsoft 365, email security, everyday tech support and routine automation checks for small businesses, offices, nonprofits and restaurant groups, from Jay Rohrs in Denver.
services.tagline: Microsoft 365, everyday support and practical automation, explained in plain words.
services.who_for: Small businesses, offices, nonprofits, and restaurant or accounting groups that do not have an in-house IT person, or whose IT person is stretched thin. I spent years as the main IT and systems resource for a restaurant-accounting firm, so I am used to explaining technical problems to people who just want their work to go smoothly.

types.name: Microsoft 365 setup and administration
types.text: User accounts, licences, permissions, Teams and SharePoint spaces, and the sign-in and access rules behind them.

types.name: Email and sign-in security
types.text: Multi-factor sign-in rolled out across a team, and mail problems such as phishing and spam traced and sorted out.

types.name: Everyday support and equipment
types.text: Remote help for people on Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android; choosing and setting up computers, printers and other office equipment; getting new people started and removing access when someone leaves; and small-office networks, domains and email hosting.

types.name: Restaurant and accounting-system checks
types.text: Running and reviewing routine automation checks in restaurant accounting software such as Restaurant365, and working with a programmer when something needs correcting.

types.name: Documentation and handover
types.text: Plain, step-by-step write-ups of how your systems work, and training so the next person can pick them up.

services.first_step: Tell me what is slowing you down. We talk it through, and if it is a fit we pick one small job to start with, such as a tidy-up of user accounts, a sign-in security check, or a written guide to a system only one person understands.

services.title: AV & Media Production
services.description: Livestreams, multi-camera hybrid events, field production, editing and documentary storytelling for churches, nonprofits and businesses, from Jay Rohrs in Denver.
services.tagline: Livestreams, live events and video that tells a clear story.
services.who_for: Churches, nonprofits, community groups and businesses that want an event streamed well, a story told on camera, or a video finished and published. I currently run livestreams and hybrid services for a Denver congregation, and I have made documentary, music and commercial video for more than twenty years.

types.name: Livestreams and hybrid events
types.text: Multi-camera coverage for people in the room and people online: camera switching, graphics, remote participants and quick fixes when something goes wrong, using tools such as Wirecast, ProPresenter and Zoom.

types.name: Church and community AV
types.text: Services and community events with PTZ cameras, sound and displays working together, plus written notes and debriefs so the setup keeps getting smoother.

types.name: Field production and documentary
types.text: Camera and audio on location, interviews, and stories told over time, from a single shoot to a 20-episode series.

types.name: Editing and delivery
types.text: Editing in Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, and publishing to YouTube.

types.name: Music, performance and short commercials
types.text: Live performance video and short commercials, from concept and casting through lighting, filming and editing.

services.first_step: Tell me about the event or the story. We talk it through, and if it is a fit we pick one small job to start with, such as livestreaming a single event or editing one short video.

services.title: AI where they meet
services.description: How AI-assisted work, routine automation checks and clear documentation connect IT and media production, from Jay Rohrs in Denver.
services.tagline: Where technology work and media work meet.
services.who_for: Organisations that already use, or are thinking about using, IT support and media production, and want them to work together instead of in separate corners. This is a short conversation page, not a separate product: it sits on top of the two tracks.

types.name: AI as an assistant, with a person in charge
types.text: I use AI-assisted research and ideas, with human editorial judgment throughout.

types.name: Routine checks that run on their own
types.text: I have run automation checks in restaurant accounting software and worked with a programmer when a check needed review. The same careful habit applies to other repeating work.

types.name: How-to material that is written and produced
types.text: My degree is in technical communication, and I have written reusable step-by-step documentation. I can also film and edit it, so a guide can be both a document and a short video.

services.ideas_intro: These are examples of what the two tracks could do together. They are starting points for talking, not a catalogue.
ideas: Video archives that are captioned and searchable.
Reports that keep an eye on business data and tell you when something looks off.
Training and how-to material that exists as both a written guide and a short video.
services.first_step: Tell me what repeats in your week, or what is sitting unused in a drawer or on a drive. We talk it through, and if it is a fit we pick one small thing to try.
